whenToUse: Settings tuned by dragging along a bounded scale, such as volume, opacity or color temperature
Ranges picked with 2 or more thumbs on a single track, laid out horizontally or vertically
Durations, storage sizes and scores read off tick marks, scale labels, a value bubble or an emoji

whenNotToUse.when: A complete shop facet panel with brands, colors, sizes and a price range
A value typed straight into a box, such as an exact price, with no scale to drag
A read only bar that reports how far a task or upload has got

agentNotes: The base `Slider` draws a thumb per entry of an array `value` or `defaultValue`; a plain number gets 2 stacked thumbs and 2 tab stops
`htmlFor` on a `Label` reaches only the root div of the base `Slider`, not its thumb input; name the slider with aria-labelledby instead
Base `onValueChange` is typed as a number or a read only array, so narrow it with `Array.isArray`; the radix twin passes a number array
